AI settings

Shared with EE Canvas — the key you set here is the one the canvas already uses. It stays in this browser and is never written into a report.

Grades and student identifiers are stored in this browser profile. A cloud API key entered here is used directly by this page; use a restricted personal/project key, leave “Remember API key” off, and clear stored data before leaving a shared computer.

Reports

Two shapes of the same grade: one the student opens inside the Assessment Player, one that stands on its own.

Student workspace

A graded submission JSON. The student opens it with Load quiz / submission JSON in the Assessment Player and the feedback appears as cards beside their own drawing on EE Canvas.

Standalone report

A portable HTML feedback sheet — scores, criterion comments, misconceptions, and a picture of the work. It opens in any browser and prints to PDF; internet access is needed to typeset MathJax equations.

Gradebook CSV for the LMS, plus a class summary sheet.
